name: FCC Community Action Fund (biodiversity, Object DA)
summary: Landfill Communities Fund grants for not-for-profit organisations in England near FCC Environment sites, including physical works that create, restore or conserve natural habitat, in scheduled quarterly rounds.

geography.label: England (sites within 10 miles of an eligible FCC Environment waste facility)

eligibility.rule: Owns, leases or holds a long-term written management agreement for the project site
Any site lease or management agreement has at least five years remaining at submission
Project site is open and accessible to the public
All work takes place at a single amenity or location
Total project cost is at most £250,000, including any applicable VAT
Previous FCC grantees wait 12 months from submitting the Completion Report before reapplying for the same site
Has a source for the FCC Environment contribution of 10.75% of the amount requested

documents: Minute or similar document authorising the primary contact to submit
Site and proposed works plans or drawings
Copies of any required planning permissions or legal consents
Contributing Third Party donor confirmation letter
Quotes, tenders or other evidence of project costs

applicant_types.quote: The FCC Community Action Fund provides grants of between £10,000 and £100,000 to not-for-profit organisations for amenity projects eligible under Object D and Object DA of the Landfill Communities Fund (LCF).

geography.quote: Only applications for projects sited within 10 miles of an eligible FCC Environment waste facility can be accepted

access.quote: To help you plan your application please download and read the relevant Guide for Applicants or click on Apply and follow the pre-application eligibility check.

window.quote: The scheduled funding rounds for the FCC Community Action Fund are as follows:

amount.quote: The FCC Community Action Fund provides grants of between £10,000 and £100,000 to not-for-profit organisations for amenity projects eligible under Object D and Object DA of the Landfill Communities Fund (LCF).

effort.quote: 2027-1 Round - opens 25 November 2026 and closes at 5.00pm on 24 February 2027
The short eligibility check will confirm whether your project can be accepted and will give you access to the application portal.
A member of our Grants Team will review each application.
These applications will then be considered by our Board of Directors, who will decide whether the project should receive funding.

eligibility.quote: Your organisation must own, lease, or hold a long-term written management agreement for the project site.
have at least five years remaining at the point of submission
the site must be open and accessible to the public.
All work must take place at a single amenity or location.
projects with a maximum total cost of £250,000, including VAT where applicable.
you must wait at least 12 months from the submission of the Completion Report before applying again for a project on the same site.
To cover this shortfall, applicants must secure a Contributing Third Party (CTP) payment. This payment is calculated as 10.75% of the amount you are requesting from us.

after_award.quote: Once your funded project has been completed, you will be required to submit post-completion reports.

documents.quote: A minute or similar document confirming that the primary contact is authorised to submit the application
Your organisation’s constitution, most recent accounts, and a recent bank statement
Plans or drawings of the site and the proposed works
Copies of any planning permissions or legal consents required for the project
A letter from your Contributing Third Party (CTP) donor confirming their willingness to act as a CTP donor for your project
Any quotes or tenders you have already obtained, or other details to show how you have calculated your project cost.
